title: CFAR detection
line: Cell-averaging CFAR at a false-alarm rate of 1e-5.
description: Cell-averaging CFAR on a range profile: each cell is compared with the average of the cells around it, scaled for a false-alarm probability of 1e-5. Two of the targets sit ten cells apart, inside each other's training window.
thumbnailAlt: A range profile with its CFAR threshold and four detections, rendered by RunMat
